b: First time taking 10 mg, took it at 9pm and it took 3 hours to feel any effect. Slept not bad for about 7 hours but after 8am it seemed to switch from a sleep aid to a stimulant. Felt like heart racing for 3 hours with anxiety. Then by noon started feeling tired and drowsy again. It’s almost 24 hours now since the first dose and I still feel doped up. I think I prefer being tired from 4 hours of sleep to being on this drug.
